source.comparability: Both releases label AZ as CoreQ Composite Score, with the same three questions, 1-to-5 response scale and 85% benchmark. FY2026 Cover A32 says 'long-stay families and their families'; the DHS CoreQ definition identifies long-stay residents and families. The payment add-on changed from $3.00 to $2.50, not the measure. Survey dates and sample sizes remain unknown; no trend is inferred.
source.selectionPolicy: FY2026 visible release sheet only. Never backfill FY2026 suppressions from hidden same-year sheets. Require a unique NF Medicaid ID, NPI and CCN, unchanged unique payment-unit name in FY2027, and one DOH-licensed nursing unit at the exact CMS street, city and ZIP with a unique state facility ID. Only select history for explicit FY2027 CoreQ suppressions, never a published current result or an indeterminate current identity.
